name: med-research-mcp
description: Evidence-graded scientific literature search for AI agents — multi-database (PubMed, Europe PMC, ChinaXiv, RussiaRxiv), built for medical, clinical and supplementation research.

tools.name: literature_search
tools.description: Search PubMed, Europe PMC, ChinaXiv and RussiaRxiv; each result is labeled with its study design, design tier and integrity flags.

tools.name: literature_fetch
tools.description: Full metadata and abstracts for specific article ids.

tools.name: literature_fulltext
tools.description: An article's full text as markdown via Unpaywall, an institutional proxy or the DOI, falling back to the abstract.

ncbiEmail.title: NCBI contact email
ncbiEmail.description: Your email, sent with every PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) request as NCBI's usage policy asks, so NCBI can contact you before blocking an IP that exceeds its limits. Also used for Unpaywall and ChinaRxiv.

ncbiApiKey.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbiApiKey.description: Raises the NCBI rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second. Leave blank if you don't have one.

unpaywallEmail.title: Unpaywall contact email (optional)
unpaywallEmail.description: Used by literature_fulltext to query Unpaywall for open-access copies. Unpaywall asks for a contact email on every request. Falls back to the NCBI email if left blank.

proxyPrefix.title: Institutional proxy prefix (optional)
proxyPrefix.description: EZproxy-style DOI prefix, e.g. https://doi-org.ezproxy.your-university.edu — literature_fulltext prepends it to the DOI. Works only if the proxy lets this computer in without a login (campus network or VPN); a proxy login in your browser isn't used. Use only if your institution's licences allow it: many publishers forbid using subscription content with AI tools.
